description: Domain TXT challenge: Checks whether a domain (or a named subdomain of it) publishes an expected token in DNS TXT, exactly or as key=token. Source: live DNS. Proves zone control at query time, nothing more. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: verified, matched_record, records_checked, checked_at.
